python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import re, datetime as dt

out = open('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics').read()

# --- structural checks ---
checks = []
checks.append(("starts with BEGIN:VCALENDAR", out.lstrip().startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR")))
checks.append(("ends with END:VCALENDAR", out.rstrip().endswith("END:VCALENDAR")))
for h in ("VERSION:2.0", "PRODID", "BEGIN:VEVENT", "END:VEVENT", "SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting"):
    checks.append((f"contains {h}", h in out))
for a in ("alice@example.com", "bob@example.com", "carol@example.com"):
    checks.append((f"attendee {a}", a in out))

m = re.search(r'DTSTART[^:]*:(\S+)', out); n = re.search(r'DTEND[^:]*:(\S+)', out)
s_raw, e_raw = m.group(1), n.group(1)
fmt_ok = all(re.fullmatch(r'\d{8}T\d{6}Z', x) for x in (s_raw, e_raw))
checks.append(("DTSTART/DTEND UTC format YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ", fmt_ok))
s = dt.datetime.strptime(s_raw, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); e = dt.datetime.strptime(e_raw, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
checks.append(("duration is 60 min", (e - s) == dt.timedelta(minutes=60)))
checks.append(("weekday within Mon-Fri", s.weekday() < 5))
checks.append(("within business hours 09:00-18:00", s.time() >= dt.time(9,0) and e.time() <= dt.time(18,0)))

# --- conflict / constraint re-check against inputs (independent of earlier script) ---
def parse(p):
    return [(dt.datetime.strptime(a,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'), dt.datetime.strptime(b,'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'))
            for a,b in re.findall(r'DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)\s*DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', open(p).read())]

def overlap(x1,x2,y1,y2): return x1 < y2 and y1 < x2

for who in ('alice','bob','carol'):
    bad = [(a,b) for a,b in parse(f'/app/{who}_calendar.ics') if overlap(s,e,a,b)]
    checks.append((f"no existing conflict for {who}", not bad))

# availability windows
checks.append(("alice >=09:00 and ends <=14:00", s.time() >= dt.time(9,0) and e.time() <= dt.time(14,0)))
checks.append(("bob starts >=10:00", s.time() >= dt.time(10,0)))
bob_end = dt.time(16,30) if s.weekday() in (1,3) else dt.time(17,0)
checks.append(("bob within end limit", e.time() <= bob_end))
checks.append(("carol avoids lunch 12:00-12:30", not overlap(s,e,dt.datetime.combine(s.date(),dt.time(12,0)),dt.datetime.combine(s.date(),dt.time(12,30)))))
checks.append(("carol ends by 17:00", e.time() <= dt.time(17,0)))

ok = True
for name, res in checks:
    print(("PASS  " if res else "FAIL  ")+name); ok &= res
print("\nChosen slot:", s.strftime('%a %Y-%m-%d %H:%M'), "-", e.strftime('%H:%M'), "UTC")
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED" if ok else "SOME CHECKS FAILED")
PYEOF
